svg.aria-label: Grid of test accuracy on the remember-the-first-bit task for six recurrent models and six gap lengths. Everything solves gaps of 5 and 10; the plain RNN and the default-initialised gated models fall to 50 percent by a gap of 40; the LSTM with forget bias 3 reaches 80 and the GRU with update bias 3 reaches 160
